title: What if calcium disappeared for 5 seconds?

S1.text: IN EVERY BONE, HEARTBEAT AND LIMESTONE
YOU: −1.1 KG ≈ A CARTON OF MILK

layers.text: You're queuing at the Colosseum in Rome.

scenes.notes: Frame 1 = cover. Sunny Colosseum, queue on a travertine kerb, marble bust on a granite plinth, YOU tagged. Title clears at 5.0 before caption 1. [screen 0.0-5.5 s]

layers.text: Every calcium atom reappears exactly where it vanished.

scenes.notes: CALCIUM BACK ONLINE: pure white light floods in from above the frame (the glows are back, but up there). 1.2 s: the sand washes over the heap anyway. [screen 67.0-69.5 s]

layers.text: Every calcium atom reappears exactly where it vanished.
But you're not standing there anymore.

scenes.notes: Camera rises: white ghost skeletons hang upright ~1 m above each heap; ghost bust over its puddle; ghost Colosseum over its sand. Ghosts start to sift down at 3.0. No gore. [screen 69.5-74.5 s]
Black, silence, HUD hidden. [screen 74.5-76.0 s]

props.fact:
99% OF YOUR CALCIUM SITS IN BONES AND TEETH.
THE REST TRIGGERS YOUR HEARTBEAT.
